title: Women pay to break things – level 2
paragraphs: Rage rooms are becoming very popular in the UK, especially for women. In these special rooms, people pay to break things like old TVs, plates, and glasses with big hammers.

About 75 percent of the customers are women who are trying to deal with work stress, busy family lives, or deep sadness after losing loved ones. Experts explain that society usually expects women to stay calm, so they don’t have many places to express anger.

Smashing things gives people a quick feeling of power and release. On the other hand, doctors say that while rage rooms are fun and help you feel better for a short time, breaking things doesn’t fix big emotional problems forever.

words.d: to break something into pieces with great force
